$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006). `rotation` defaults to 0 for `surface` and `free` hosts; hosts live in extension elements, which the canonical form never changes (9.2), so the default carries no `default` keyword here: the canonicalizer does not omit it.
title: Host
description: 13.3: what an extension element is placed on. A host MUST have exactly the members of one of its three forms (FS-CORE-13.3.1). That its wall, room or level resolves (FS-CORE-3.2.1), and that it fits its host (FS-CORE-13.3.2 to 13.3.5), are invariants, not checked here.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 13.3: which of the three forms this host has.

wallFace.title: Wall-face host
wallFace.description: 13.3: on a face of a wall.

wall.description: 13.3: a reference to the host wall.

side.title: Side
side.description: 13.3: which face of the wall, seen along its direction.

offset.description: 13.3: the distance along the wall's location line from its start junction; not negative.

height.description: 13.3: the height above the wall's base elevation; not negative.

surface.title: Surface host
surface.description: 13.3: on the floor or the ceiling of a room.

room.description: 13.3: a reference to the host room.

rotation.description: 13.1, 13.3: the direction it faces, counter-clockwise from +X. Absent: 0.
13.1, 13.3: the direction it faces, counter-clockwise from +X. Absent: 0.
